title: How Vic Giurgiu went from teen dev agency owner to AI affiliate SaaS founder
summary: Vic recounts going from game-dev freelancer to agency owner to a SaaS founder at 16, and why he left project work for recurring revenue. He shares how he validates ideas, ships MVPs fast, and pivoted his product from marketers to companies.

principles.text: Validate with a landing page and outreach before you build anything.
principles.quote: before starting to build your product just put up a quick landing page about what you want to do put an email collection section

principles.text: Weight feedback from experts in the field over friends and family.
principles.quote: if they are experts in that field then their opinion will matter 10 times more than you telling your friends or your parents about your idea

principles.text: Ship the MVP as fast as possible so you can test, iterate and pivot.
principles.quote: it's important to get your product on the market as quick as possible and try to test it and iterate it

principles.text: Sell to businesses rather than individuals, since companies have more budget.
principles.quote: businesses are always going to have more revenue and more Capital than than marketers and then Affiliates and then people in general

principles.text: Look for repetitive tasks companies already pay people to do, and automate them with AI.
principles.quote: there are companies that already pay uh people a lot of money monthly just to do this repetitive task

principles.text: Prefer recurring revenue over one-off project work.
principles.quote: the recurring Revenue right so the fact that you get money every month that's a huge thing
